structured.answer: The page picks the cheapest pair for me: open the account at פסגות and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" (5139282). With the page's own numbers (10,000 ₪ to start, 500 ₪ a month, 10 years, 7%), I would put in 70,000 ₪ and end up with about 86,492 ₪. I would not act before my son checks it with me.

stuck.why: The page came already filled with 10,000, 500, 10 years and 7%. I didn't know whether the 7% is promised or just an assumption, and I didn't touch the sliders.
Many red minus numbers (-447, -1,268, -4,492 ₪) made me afraid. Then came English fund names (iShares, Vanguard, UCITS ETF, IE00...) and I stopped reading.
My bank Hapoalim shows 81,471 against 86,492 at Pesagot. Pesagot is not a bank I've ever used, so I don't know whether to trust it.
